limits: Bounded complete calendar wording; next week means next Monday through Sunday, one/two weeks means seven/fourteen calendar days, a month means the same calendar day next month.
Next weekday means that weekday in the next calendar week; plain weekday means the next occurrence; past this-week dates clarify. Resolved dates are spoken before any selection.
Named dates use the current clinic year; invalid/past dates and impossible month days clarify rather than guessing another year or clamping.

Only exact whole-minute selected source clocks support same time next week, same time on an explicit ISO date and thirty minutes earlier/later on the same day; missing/unplayed/expired sources cannot supply authority.
Unqualified relative searches retain caller clock constraints; explicit clock qualifiers provide the new disclosed search window.
Approved horizon, fresh Cliniko source/offer proof, separate played confirmation, one possible send and no automatic retry remain enforced.
Transient source starts/expiry never enter model context or durable Abby patient storage.
Synthetic voice, mail, clinic approval and provider evidence; no real carrier, clinic activation or new real-model pass.
